procedure: Separate one-time package development, sourcepack collection and environment preparation from each company engagement and its retries, fresh evidence collection, calculation, review, rendering and delivery.

Bind estimates and actuals to task ID/revision, attempt and risk/control/review coverage. Record currency, unit, rate source/date, observed tokens/cache split, elapsed intervals and uncertainty; unknown cost or usage is not zero. Prevent double counting shared setup and parallel wall-clock intervals.

Compare only options preserving mandatory checks and approved settings. Record forecast versus actual and cost tradeoffs; do not invent a cheapest feasible option. Report budget is exactly 600 seconds: 585 work plus 15 preservation/delivery; preparation is separate and engagement work cannot be relabeled setup.

acceptance.expectation: Current inputs and actual plan task/risk bindings are recorded; stale inputs return restricted results.
Named outputs reflect performed work, uncertainty and method-specific limits; risk evidence grants no authority.

conditions: Acceptance test fails or remains unperformed
failure.record: failure_records; affected object, missing evidence/test, owner, next action and restriction
